metas.name: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival
metas.description:
Genres: Action, Adventure, Fantasy Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she’s determined to carve her own path.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

metas.name: Nue no Onmyouji

(Source: Manga Plus)

metas.name: Shibatsuki Bukken
metas.description:
Genres: Comedy, Slice of Life, Supernatural Spacious apartment in a new building, an expansive kitchen with an induction stove, a bathroom with a separated toilet, and even a washroom, all for just... 4800 yen a month?! But there is a spooky reason Maison Shiba is so doggone affordable...

The room high schooler Kori Momose was offered came with a room mate: Mu-chan, a Shiba Inu who happens to be an earthbound spirit. With the ultimate goal of a comfortable lifestyle with no roommates, Kori tries all kinds of strategies to unbind Mu from room 101.

Get ready for a heartwarming comedy at Maison Shiba,full of quirky neighbors, adorable Shiba inus, and plenty of fluffy, chaotic fun!

(Source: SHIBA INU ROOMS Official Site)
